title: Turning the dissociation analysis's PROJECTION into a MEASUREMENT: button's control family at L18 extended from 10 to 46, the family size basket's passing reads used
frozen_before_reading: any of the 36 new button-at-L18 control arms. NONE of them has ever been run: I enumerated outputs/boombness/score_behavior/ for csi1_button_train_KO_RAND6..21 and csi1_button_train_KO_SHUF4..23 and found ZERO directories -- there is not even a tag collision to disambiguate. What IS already read, and is declared in full below, is the 10-control stage-1 family (rank 8 of 11, reports/DCS_CSI_SUBSPACE_button_train_L18.json).
opened_by_entry: the post-hoc analysis reports/DCS_CSI_BUTTON_BASKET_DISSOCIATION_ANALYSIS.md, section 12, experiment E2
opened_by_instruction: Write and freeze the preregistration for the experiment that turns that projection into a measurement -- and which is a genuine FALSIFIER of the analysis that proposed it.
question: The sprint's central open result is a CODEWORD DISSOCIATION: basket's rank-1 installation axis is strictly the largest of its 46 norm-matched controls on both splits at L18 (rank 1 of 47, p = 0.02128), while button's is rank 8 of 11 at the same layer. The two reads are not at matched resolution: 46 controls versus 10. reports/DCS_CSI_BUTTON_BASKET_DISSOCIATION_ANALYSIS.md refuted 'unequal control families' as the EXPLANATION four ways, and then PROJECTED, from button's own 7-of-10 exceedance count via a Jeffreys Beta-binomial predictive calibrated on basket's own 10->46 transition, that button at 46 controls would land at E[rank] = 32.4 of 47. This preregistration exists so that projection can FAIL.
why_this_is_not_a_second_bite: This experiment cannot make button pass and is not run in the hope that it will. It is run because the analysis that concluded 'the dissociation is REAL' made a sharp, falsifiable quantitative prediction about an unrun measurement, and the measurement is cheap. The asymmetry is deliberate and runs AGAINST the author's own conclusion: every outcome either confirms a prediction the author already published, or destroys the method that produced it. PR-CSI-004 is the symmetric experiment on the basket side (basket L20, 10 -> 46) and was frozen earlier the same day; this is the button side, and unlike PR-CSI-004 it has no possibility of certifying anything.
what_is_actually_at_stake: Not whether button passes -- see arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank below, which shows the pooled rank is bounded at R47 >= 8 (p >= 0.1702) before a single new arm runs. What is at stake is (a) whether the 10-control family was REPRESENTATIVE of the 46, which is the last surviving form of candidate C3, and (b) whether the Beta-binomial projection method used in section 4.2 of the analysis -- and used there to justify the sentence 'Extending button's family cannot manufacture a pass' -- actually predicts. If the projection fails, section 4.2 is withdrawn and with it the quantitative half of the analysis's refutation of C3.

Every one is gated on the new donor: `--rescue-donor` gains the choice 'ko'; `if args.rescue_donor == "self"` becomes `in ("self", "ko")` with 'self' behaviour unchanged; `ctxs = list(ctxs) + [_rescue_ctx]` becomes an if/else whose else-branch is the identical original line and whose if-branch requires rescue_donor == "ko"; and the three `_kf = {**_kf, **_rescue_row_fields(...)}` lines gain `**(_necessity_row_fields(...) if args.rescue_donor == "ko" else {})`. rank_needed_to_certify_at_alpha_0_05: rank 1 or 2 of 47 (p = 0.02128 or 0.04255). Rank 3 of 47 is p = 0.06383 and does not certify.

arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank.the_fact: The 10 already-read controls are a SUBSET of the 46. Seven of them recover at least as much as the candidate. Therefore at least seven of the 46 do, and R47 = 1 + #{controls >= candidate} >= 8 NECESSARILY, for p >= 8/47 = 0.17021.
arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank.consequence_stated_plainly: AT THE POOLED FAMILY SIZE BUTTON CANNOT PASS, AND CANNOT REACH RANK 1 OR 2, BEFORE A SINGLE NEW ARM RUNS. This is not a prediction; it is arithmetic on committed numbers. Any preregistration of this experiment that presents 'rank 1 or 2 of 47' as a live possibility of the POOLED read is wrong, and this file says so in advance rather than discovering it afterwards.
arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank.the_one_way_the_floor_could_move: The analyser recomputes all 47 recoveries on a NEW cross-arm key intersection (17 arms gave n_keys_common 658; adding 36 arms can only shrink it, as D12's 53-arm read at L18 shrank to 642). A stage-1 control could in principle cross the candidate under the new intersection. I measured how far each would have to move: the seven exceedance margins over the candidate are +0.00014 (KO_SHUF1), +0.00025 (KO_RAND1), +0.00048 (KO_SHUF0), +0.00057 (KO_RAND2), +0.00076 (KO_SHUF2), +0.00154 (KO_RAND5), +0.00178 (KO_RAND3), against a control sd of 0.000910. Reaching rank <= 2 requires flipping at least five of the seven, i.e. moving a control by >= 0.00076 = 0.84 sd, purely from a key-set change. For scale, the analysis's own section-0 rebuild of the same quantities on the same key set agreed to 4.5e-06.
arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank.and_if_it_DOES_move: then two things are true at once and BOTH must be reported: the dissociation conclusion is withdrawn (see falsification_criterion) AND the pipeline's stability under key re-intersection is a finding in its own right that puts every rank in the sprint in question. It would not be a clean win for either side.

pooling_question.why_this_block_exists: The 10 stage-1 controls have ALREADY BEEN READ: rank 8 of 11 is committed in reports/DCS_CSI_SUBSPACE_button_train_L18.json and is quoted throughout the sprint. Extending a control family after seeing where the candidate sits inside it is the classic way a valid rank test becomes a post-hoc one. This block decides the question from the rank statistic's null distribution, before any new arm runs, exactly as PR-CSI-004 had to.
pooling_question.the_null: H0: the candidate direction cand_rank1 is exchangeable with its norm-matched control directions with respect to y_install recovery (KO_X - KO), domain-clustered. Under H0 the candidate's rank among itself and its K controls is uniform on {1,...,K+1}, so p = rank/(K+1).

hazard_1_control_SELECTION_after_seeing_.the_hazard: If WHICH controls were added depended on the 10 already-read values, exchangeability is destroyed.
REFUTED_three_ways: All 46 control directions were drawn into configs/dcs_csi_axis_button_behavioral_L18.pt under seed 20260915, and the file's mtime is 2026-09-16 21:22 -- before job 902005 (which started 21:19:55 and first wrote an arm at 21:36:51) had produced any control value. No direction is drawn now.

The 10 run first were not chosen: group B's arm list (ctrl_shuffled0-3, ctrl_random0-5) is hard-coded at slurm_scripts/dcs_csi_p1_arms.slurm:163-166 and was written for PR-CSI-001, long before button-at-L18 existed. The stage-1 subset is fixed by a script, not by an outcome.
The 36 being added are the ENTIRE complement, taken whole. Groups I1, I2 and K together emit exactly those 36 and nothing else; there is no selection among them.

hazard_2_data_dependent_CONTINUATION_opt.the_hazard: PR-CSI-002's frozen decision rule continues to 46 controls only when the stage-1 rank is 1, 2 or 3 of 11 and stops at rank 4 or worse. Button's stage-1 rank is 8 of 11. THE SPRINT'S OWN RULE SAYS STOP. This continuation is therefore happening OUTSIDE that rule, and the honest description of the continuation event is C = {R11 >= 4} -- we are continuing precisely BECAUSE stage 1 failed. That is data-dependent continuation and must be analysed, not waved past.
hazard_2_data_dependent_CONTINUATION_opt.the_analysis: Rejection region {R46 <= 2} is CONTAINED in {R11 <= 2} (at most one of 46 controls beating the candidate implies at most one of the 10 does), hence in {R11 <= 3}, which is DISJOINT from C = {R11 >= 4}. Therefore P(C and R46 <= 2 | H0) = 0. Continuing on a stage-1 FAILURE cannot manufacture a rejection: the type-I error of the whole two-stage procedure as actually executed is ZERO, not inflated. The direction of the selection is entirely conservative.
hazard_2_data_dependent_CONTINUATION_opt.the_symmetric_statement_for_PR_CSI_004: PR-CSI-004 continued on {R11 <= 3} and showed the same containment makes the futility stop able only to DISCARD rejections, giving an unconditional type-I error of exactly 2/47 = 0.042553. Button continues on the complement and gets 0. The two preregistrations use the identical containment fact and land on opposite ends of it. Neither is inflated.
hazard_2_data_dependent_CONTINUATION_opt.VERDICT: POOLING THE 10 ALREADY-READ CONTROLS WITH THE 36 NEW ONES INTO ONE FAMILY OF 46 IS LEGITIMATE. It does not make the test post-hoc and it does not inflate type-I error in any direction. A clean 46-draw family is NOT required on those grounds.
hazard_2_data_dependent_CONTINUATION_opt.BUT_and_this_is_the_price: The same containment that makes pooling safe is what makes the pooled rank test VACUOUS as a falsifier here: type-I error zero because the rejection region is unreachable (arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank). A test that cannot reject is not a test. So pooling is legitimate AND insufficient, and the primary endpoint below is therefore NOT the pooled rank.

the_resolution_and_it_is_the_point_of_th.what_is_actually_blind: The 36 new controls have never been run. Let X = #{of the 36 NEW controls whose recovery >= the candidate's}. X is unread, unselected and, under H0, exchangeable. X -- not the pooled rank -- is the quantity the dissociation analysis's projection predicts, and it is the quantity this experiment can falsify.
the_resolution_and_it_is_the_point_of_th.the_pooled_rank_is_retained_as_the_HEADL: R47 = 1 + (stage-1 exceedances recomputed) + X is reported because it is the number that sits beside basket's 1 of 47 at matched family size, which is the whole reason the experiment was asked for. It is reported as a MEASUREMENT with its floor of 8 declared here in advance, never as a test.
the_resolution_and_it_is_the_point_of_th.the_alternative_design_if_the_answer_had: Had pooling been illegitimate -- or had the sprint wanted a POOLED rank test with a live rejection region -- the design would have been a CLEAN FAMILY: draw 46 fresh norm-matched control directions with a NEW seed into configs/dcs_csi_axis_button_L18_family2.pt, run all 46 at L18, re-run the candidate, and DISCARD the 10 already read entirely. Cost: 46 + 1 = 47 arms (10.97 GPU-hours at the measured 840.110 s/arm) plus one CPU axis rebuild. It is NOT taken now, because pooling is legitimate and because the clean family would still, on every projection available, land button around rank 32 of 47. It is preregistered here as the MANDATORY escalation under exactly one outcome, named in the decision rule: X <= 1.

what_WOULD_make_this_post_hoc_and_is_the: Adding only SOME of the 36, or choosing which to add after the fact. All 36 run; all 46 enter.

Reading the new arms in sub-batches and stopping when the count looks good. NO INTERIM READ. Exactly one read, at the end, over all 47. No per-arm recovery value is computed until every arm that is going to run has finished.

Re-running any of the 10 stage-1 arms and keeping whichever copy helps. The 10 are frozen at jobs 902004/902005 by the --require-slurm-job filter in the frozen read. CODEANCHOR_R0 is a bit-identity CHECK on a separate tag and a separate job and may never be substituted for KO_RAND0 in the family.

Extending the family AGAIN after this read. 46 is D12's resolution and this preregistration's terminal K for the pooled design. The only licensed escalation is the CLEAN 46-draw family, under the single outcome X <= 1, and it REPLACES this family rather than adding to it.
Reporting the stage-1 rank-8-of-11 result and the stage-2 result as two independent confirmations of the dissociation. They share 10 controls, the candidate and the same rows. There is ONE result.
Quoting the pooled p >= 0.17021 as evidence FOR the dissociation without stating that its floor of 8 was arithmetically fixed in advance by the 7 committed exceedances.

primary_endpoint: y_install -- the concept-free one-word installation readout (semantic_one_word, whole_answer), domain-clustered
statistical_unit: DOMAIN. There are 67. Rows estimate within-domain means only and NEVER inflate n. Any bootstrap resamples DOMAINS, not rows.
estimator: per arm, recovery = mean over the 67 domain means of (arm - KO), where each domain mean is the mean of y_install over that domain's rows in the cross-arm common key intersection. Candidate recovery = KO_AXIS - KO; each control's recovery = KO_X - KO, computed identically. The analyser's option-mass gate, --allow-short 4 and key intersection are applied to candidate and controls alike.
positions: query span, all ~28 positions (--rescue-positions query). NOT a single named row; group J's rel-10 codeword-row variant is a different experiment and is not part of this one.

primary_statistic.name: X -- the number of the 36 NEW, never-read controls whose recovery is >= the candidate's
primary_statistic.why_this_and_not_the_pooled_rank: It is the only blind quantity in the experiment, and it is exactly what the dissociation analysis's Beta-binomial predictive forecasts. The pooled rank's rejection region is unreachable (see arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank); X's is not.
primary_statistic.reference_distribution: the analysis's own predictive, stated in prediction_fixed_before_data, NOT a fresh null. This is a test of a PREDICTION, not a test of H0.

secondary_statistics_PRESPECIFIED.S1_pooled_rank: R47, the candidate's rank among itself and all 46 controls, with its attainable floor 1/47 = 0.02128 and its arithmetic floor of 8 both reported alongside it. Reported as the number comparable with basket's 1 of 47; never as a test.
secondary_statistics_PRESPECIFIED.S2_family_size_free_z: z = (candidate - mean(controls)) / sd(controls) over the 46. This statistic does NOT improve with more controls, so it is the honest cross-family comparison against basket's +2.561 (TRAIN, 46 controls). Button's committed value on the 10 is -0.376.
secondary_statistics_PRESPECIFIED.S3_shuffled_only_subfamily: the same rank restricted to the 24 ctrl_shuffled controls (floor 1/25 = 0.0400). R5/S-099/S-100 found random and shuffled exchangeable in LOCATION but the shuffled sd 1.9x the random sd, so the shuffled tail sets the margin. At button L18 the measured shuffled/random sd ratio is 0.65, i.e. the pattern is REVERSED for button, and this subfamily read tests whether that survives at 24 shuffled controls. SECONDARY. It may NOT be substituted for the primary.
secondary_statistics_PRESPECIFIED.S4_exceedance_rate_with_a_Clopper_Pearso: p_exceed = (stage-1 exceedances + X)/46 with an exact binomial CI, to be placed beside basket's 0/46 [0.000, 0.077].

the_reasoning_stated_so_it_can_be_held_a: I expect X to be in the low-to-mid twenties and R47 to be in the high twenties or thirties. I record that expectation so that a surprise cannot later be described as anything other than a result that overturns a projection I already held.

falsification_criterion.the_sentence_this_preregistration_exists: If button comes back at rank 1 or 2 of 47, the 'dissociation is real' conclusion of reports/DCS_CSI_BUTTON_BASKET_DISSOCIATION_ANALYSIS.md is WRONG and must be withdrawn.
falsification_criterion.written_in_those_words_and_binding: That is the criterion, it is frozen here before any new arm runs, and it is not negotiable after the fact. If rank 1 or 2 of 47 is what comes back, the analysis's section 13 conclusion is withdrawn, its C3 verdict of 'REFUTED as the explanation' is reversed to 'C3 STANDS', D12's framing is in serious trouble, and the sprint's headline may no longer be stated as a codeword dissociation.
falsification_criterion.the_honest_arithmetic_that_goes_with_it: Under POOLING that outcome requires the analyser's recomputation on the shrunken key intersection to flip at least five of the seven committed stage-1 exceedances, i.e. to move a control by >= 0.84 control-sd. It cannot be produced by the 36 new controls alone, because the 10 are members of the 46. So the criterion is retained verbatim AND its only mechanism is named: if it fires, it fires through pipeline instability, and that instability is then itself a reportable finding that impeaches every rank in the sprint, basket's 1 of 47 included.
falsification_criterion.the_REACHABLE_falsifier_which_is_the_pri: X, the exceedance count among the 36 blind controls, refutes the analysis's projection whenever X falls below the projection's own 97.5% predictive interval, i.e. X <= 12 (predictive P <= 2.297e-02). At X <= 12 the analysis's section 4.2 -- and the sentence 'Extending button's family cannot manufacture a pass', and the claim that the method is calibrated on basket -- are WITHDRAWN, whatever the pooled rank says.
falsification_criterion.the_SEVERE_branch: X <= 4 (predictive P <= 2.055e-04). At that point the 10-control stage-1 family is demonstrably unrepresentative of the 46, candidate C3 is RESURRECTED in the form 'the small families were unrepresentative', the analysis's section 4.1 matched-family argument is reopened, and the CLEAN 46-draw family becomes MANDATORY rather than optional.
what_does_NOT_count_as_falsification: A pooled rank in the twenties or thirties. That is the prediction succeeding.

A pooled rank of exactly 8 reached with X = 0. X = 0 has predictive probability 6.461e-07 and WOULD be a severe refutation of the projection -- but it must be reported as X = 0, not as 'rank 8, unchanged from stage 1', which would hide the most extreme possible outcome behind an unchanged-looking headline.
A candidate point value that moves off -0.00027. The key intersection shrinks when 36 arms are added; that is declared in advance.

MDE_and_power.on_the_PRIMARY: The design distinguishes the projected exceedance probability of 0.6818 from any value <= 0.333 at the one-sided 2.5% level of the projection's own predictive (X <= 12 of 36 gives p_hat <= 0.3333, predictive P = 2.297e-02), and from <= 0.111 at the 2.055e-04 level (X <= 4). With 36 blind draws the binomial se at p = 0.68 is sqrt(0.68*0.32/36) = 0.0778, so the design resolves the exceedance probability to about +/- 0.15 at 95%. That is ample to tell 0.68 from the ~0.02 that basket exhibits.
MDE_and_power.on_the_pooled_rank: ZERO power to reject, by construction (arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank). Declared here so that a null is never reported as 'underpowered' when it was unrejectable by arithmetic, and never as 'confirmatory' when no rejection was available.
MDE_and_power.on_the_family_size_free_z: the 46-control family gives sd(controls) to within a factor sqrt(2*45)^-1 ~ 10%, against the 10-control family's ~24%, so S2's comparison with basket's +2.561 becomes about 2.3x tighter. This is the one statistic that genuinely improves from the extension and it is a comparison, not a test.
MDE_and_power.what_would_be_needed_to_give_button_a_re: A candidate recovery exceeding the maximum of 46 norm-matched controls. The 10-control maximum is +0.00151; a 46-draw maximum from the same distribution would sit near +0.0020-0.0025. Button's candidate is -0.00027, about 2.0-2.8 control-sd short. No family size fixes that, which is precisely the analysis's point and precisely what is being put at risk.

on_the_pooled_rank_R47_reported_as_a_mea.3 <= R47 <= 7: also arithmetically impossible from the 36 alone; treat exactly as the 1-or-2 branch minus the withdrawal, i.e. as a pipeline finding requiring investigation before any scientific reading.

what_this_experiment_does_NOT_settle: It cannot explain WHY the two codewords differ. It can only confirm or refute THAT they differ at matched family size. The analysis killed six candidate explanations and left the residual unexplained; nothing here touches that residual.
It cannot make button pass, and it is not designed to. See arithmetic_floor_on_the_pooled_rank.

It says nothing about button on the HELD-OUT split. No button-at-L18 VALIDATION arm has ever been run, and this preregistration does not create one. The dissociation's strongest evidence, per the analysis's own section 13, is the held-out split -- and on the button side at L18 that evidence does not exist.

It says nothing about button at its OWN layer L20, whose 46-control family would additionally need 33 new bases built first (configs/dcs_csi_axis_button_behavioral.json holds only 8 random + 5 shuffled rank-1 controls).
It says nothing about the NECESSITY direction (--rescue-donor ko), which is PR-CSI-003/003A.
It cannot revive the LAYER as the explanation of the dissociation. S-104's button-at-L18 failure already excluded that, and no outcome here brings it back.
It does not test candidate C1 ('basket's probe is simply a better probe'), the one explanation left standing. That is experiment E1, the axis swap, and it is a different preregistration.
must_not_be_said_if_positive: NOT 'button passes' or 'the dissociation is refuted' on the strength of a pooled rank in the single digits. The pooled rank's floor of 8 was fixed by arithmetic before the experiment, and a rank below it is a pipeline event, not a pass.

NOT 'the control families were unequal all along, so the dissociation was an artifact' without also reporting the analysis's section 4.1 matched-10 comparison (basket rank 1 of 11 vs button rank 8 of 11 at the SAME layer, same 6-random/4-shuffled composition), which is independent of this experiment and is not overturned by a low X alone.
NOT 'button's axis is causal'. Prohibition 19 stands. Button's candidate at L18 recovers -0.25% of what the whole clean state recovers; a rank cannot enlarge an effect.
NOT 'this replicates anything'. It is one split, TRAIN, one codeword, one layer, and it shares its rows with the read it extends.
NOT 'the projection method is sound' from a confirmation. One confirmed prediction on the cell it was fit to is weak evidence for a method whose basket calibration figure I could not reproduce.
must_not_be_said_if_null: NOT 'the dissociation is now proven'. A rank of 32 of 47 for button is the ABSENCE of an effect for button; it is not a positive result, and it certifies nothing. Basket's 1 of 47 is the only certified cell and it remains the only one.

NOT 'C3 is closed'. What is closed is the version of C3 that says button would reach rank 1 given 46 controls. The versions that survive -- unequal power (C8, 1.2-2.4x of a 4-6x gap) and the better probe (C1, +12% LOO rho, unquantified) -- are untouched.
NOT 'the codewords differ because ...'. This experiment supplies no mechanism. The residual is still the codeword and it is still unexplained.
NOT 'nearly significant' about anything. p >= 0.17021 by construction and there is nothing to be near.

NOT 'the TRAIN own-layer headline is now supported'. The analysis's section 13 point 1 stands: the TRAIN own-layer cell is the WEAKEST evidence in the set (delta-z CI [-0.226, +4.288], matched-family Fisher p = 0.105), and this experiment is at the SHARED layer and does not speak to it.
